verdict.summary: The change correctly threads the same QueryBudget through both variable-graph authorization resolution and update application, preserves the existing unlimited entry points, and keeps budget exhaustion distinct from authorization denial. The tests include real-path positive controls, mutation guards, authorization-stage and apply-stage coverage, WAC/ACP parity, and the documented WHERE-less boundary. Public API documentation and the matching skills are updated. No correctness, soundness, security, or vacuous-test issue is evident in the diff.
